offering_description.value: Provides infusion pumps and related services to oncology practices, hospitals and other providers in the US and Canada. Rents, sells, services and repairs pumps for chemotherapy, pain management and other therapies. Also offers biomedical repair and pump recycling services.

primary_products.value: ambulatory infusion pumps; pain management pumps; used and refurbished pumps; pump accessories and disposables

primary_services.value: infusion pump rental and management; biomedical maintenance and repair; pump recycling and remarketing; home infusion pump services

customer_segment.value: B2B: oncology clinics, hospitals, home infusion providers, surgery centers, pain management practices and pump manufacturers

end_markets.value: oncology; pain management; home infusion; healthcare

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: rental of infusion pumps to clinics, billed to providers and payors; product sales: sales of new and used pumps and accessories; service fees: biomedical repair, maintenance and pump management; healthcare reimbursement: reimbursement from insurance payors for pump rentals
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees; healthcare reimbursement

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys pumps from manufacturers, rents and services them for healthcare providers; asset operator: owns fleet of rental infusion pumps deployed to clinics; distributor: resells new and refurbished pumps and supplies to providers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: pump rentals, pump sales, biomedical repair and recycling, all centered on infusion pumps

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales team selling to oncology practices, hospitals and home infusion providers; own locations: regional service centers in the US and Canada shipping pumps to customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA medical device rules, payor reimbursement requirements and healthcare compliance laws such as anti-kickback
